description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.
The ID of the member account that you want to delete from WAF.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region in which the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs.

description.zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取。
description.en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains this value.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi delete-member-account --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id waf_esasdf30000 --source-ip 0.0.XX.XX --member-account-id 1310000000000039 --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
